title: Darth Maul
subtitle: Sith Revealed
text: Action [Exhaust, use the Force (lose your Force token)]: Deal 1 damage to a unit and 1 damage to a different unit.
deployBox: On Attack: Deal 1 damage to a unit and 1 damage to a different unit.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
All damage dealt by Maul's abilities is dealt simultaneously.
When using Maul's ability, you must deal damage to 2 units if you can.
You can use Maul's unit ability to damage himself.
